newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana Stock Exchange rises but lower on week.
newsitem.headline: Ghana Stock Exchange rises but lower on week.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange closed higher on Friday after another session marked by thin trade, but the index closed down on the week, its trading report showed.
The GSE All-Share Index rose 1.42 points to end the week at 382.9 points from 381.54 on Wednesday. On Monday, the index stood at 384.31 points, down from last Friday's 384.39.
Offers outstripped bids by 1,573,970 to 135,060. A mere 14,670 shares were traded, down on Wednesday's equally modest 15,370.
Traders have blamed lack of turnover on the exchange this year on competition from more attractive government bond issues.
Market capitalisation rose to 3,208.98 billion cedis from 3,206.96 billion cedis on Wednesday. It stood at 3,256.84 billion cedis on Monday. ($1=1,700 cedis)
